subfiles.summary: This file index lists one paper under the subject “Silver - Japan.” The entry records a July 5 report from Kobe by Gourley concerning developments in Japan’s silver sector, particularly the expansion of government control. The year has been interpreted as 1939 because the OCR’s “1959” falls outside the stated 1930–1949 record series and is evidently a misreading.

interest: Although the substantive report is absent, this sheet preserves useful archival metadata for locating or reconstructing it. Its brief description points to increasing Japanese state intervention in the silver sector in 1939, a subject relevant to economic mobilization and wartime resource policy. The entry also documents Gourley’s reporting from Kobe and retains the contemporary routing notation “FR AM/C EA.”
